title: 第二十八章这是锻体四阶？
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
出了南门，叶凡没走官道。

    官道平坦好走，可两旁茶棚酒肆林立，进出的修士太多。

    他这张脸刚露过头，任务大厅里一帮人都记着，犯不着自己往眼皮底下凑。

    绕进南边的荒山，叶凡撒开了腿。

    二转肉身，配上那套合成出来的《疾风飘叶》，跑起来不像赶路，倒像贴着地皮飘。

    脚尖一点石头，借着步法的劲儿往前蹿，一蹿就是丈把远。

    山林里的枝桠扫过来，他侧身一让，半点没沾着。

    跑了大半夜，叶凡寻了处背风的石窝歇脚。

    盘膝坐下，先把《九龙搬血》运了一遍。

    体内那点稀薄灵气循着经脉走，骨头缝里、血肉深处的力道被一点点压实，沉到底。

    二转之后，他这身肉骨头，灵气越藏得深，外头看着越是孱弱。锻体四阶的表象，稳压着。

    调完息，他摸了摸怀里。

    赤金小炉，贴身。

    那柄合出来的小飞剑，在另一侧。

    剩的几颗丹药，零碎灵石，都归置在贴身的小袋里，扎得死紧。

    齐了。

    叶凡闭着眼，没再多想。

    明儿一早赶到雷劫地，抓鸡。

    至于那位等在路上想割他脑袋的王师兄，撞上来再说。

    天蒙亮，他又起身赶路。

    日头爬到头顶，再往西斜，焦黑的地界就到了眼前。

    叶凡停下脚。

    记忆里没这地方。

    八十年前下山，他还是个扫地的杂役，哪到得了这种地界。

    眼前这片地，黑得发亮，像被烧透了，地皮上纵横交错全是裂口，深的能塞进个人。

    裂缝里头，时不时窜出一道银白的电光。

    那电光不大，可窜得快，沿着地缝游一圈，啪的炸开，焦土被崩起一小撮。

    残雷。

    说书的、任务牌上写的，都没夸大。

    这地方，寻常修士进来，沾上一道就得脱层皮，多挨几下，命都得搁这儿。

    叶凡没急着进。

    他蹲在雷区边上，看了半晌那残雷炸响的路数，才慢探出一只脚，踩进了焦土里。

    刚落下，地缝里一道银光就奔他脚踝来了。

    啪。

    电光在他小腿上炸开。

    叶凡顿了一下。

    不疼。就一股酥麻的劲儿，顺着腿往上爬了爬，到膝盖就散了。

    他心里那块石头，落了地。

    二转重塑过的肉身，连废丹洞那种能把活人腐成白骨的毒瘴都不沾，这点雷劫剩下的余威，挠痒似的。

    叶凡站直了，干脆往雷区深处走。

    走得不快，脚下那些残雷一道接一道地往他身上招呼，崩在皮肉上，全成了酥麻。

    他低头看了看自己的青衣，倒是被烧出几个焦黑的破洞。

    衣裳遭罪，人没事。

    “早知道，把那身被毒瘴腐烂的破布留着穿来了。”

    叶凡嘟囔了一句，脚下没停。

    越往里走，地势越是破碎。焦岩一块支棱着，挡了视线。

    就在他绕过一块半人高的黑岩时，前头脚步声闷地响起来。

    一道身影从焦岩后头踱了出来，横在他道上。

    个头近两米，胳膊上的腱子肉一块绷着，青衣的料子被那身横肉撑得紧巴。
content_en:
After leaving the south gate, Ye Fan did not take the official road.

    The official road is flat and easy to walk, but there are many teahouses and restaurants on both sides, and there are too many monks coming in and out.

    His face had just been revealed, and everyone in the mission hall remembered it, so they didn't have to hide it under their noses.

    Going around the barren mountains in the south, Ye Fan spread his legs.

    The second-turn physical body, coupled with the synthesized set of "Flying Leaves in the Wind", does not feel like running, but like floating on the ground.

    With a little stone on the tip of his toes, he used the strength of his footwork to jump forward, covering a distance of ten feet in one jump.

    The branches in the forest swept over him, and he stepped aside, not touching them at all.

    After running for most of the night, Ye Fan found a stone nest leeward to rest.

    I sat down cross-legged and read "The Blood of Nine Dragons" first.

    The thin spiritual energy in the body follows the meridians, and the strength in the seams of the bones and deep in the flesh is compacted little by little, sinking to the bottom.

    After the second transformation, his body of flesh and bones and spiritual energy were hidden deeper and weaker, and he looked weaker from the outside. The appearance of the fourth level of body training is stable.

    After adjusting his breath, he touched his arms.

    Red gold small stove, close to the body.

    The folded small flying sword is on the other side.

    The few remaining pills and scattered spiritual stones were placed in a small bag close to his body and tied tightly.

    All ready.

    Ye Fan closed his eyes and didn't think any more.

    I'll go to Leijie Land early tomorrow morning to catch chickens.

    As for Senior Brother Wang who was waiting on the road and wanted to cut off his head, let's wait until he bumps into him.

    At dawn, he got up and started on his way again.

    The sun climbed to the top of the head, and then tilted to the west, and the scorched land was in front of us.

    Ye Fan stopped.

    There is no such place in my memory.

    When he came down from the mountain eighty years ago, he was still a handyman sweeping the floors. How could he reach such a position.

    The land in front of me was shiny black, as if it had been burned through. The land was crisscrossed with cracks, deep enough for a person to fit into.

    From time to time, a silvery electric light shot out from inside the crack.

    The electric light was not big, but it traveled very fast. It swam along a crack in the ground and exploded, causing a small amount of scorched earth to collapse.

    Residual thunder.

    The storyteller and what is written on the mission card are not exaggerated.

    If an ordinary monk comes into this place, his skin will peel off if he touches it once. If he gets a few more times, his life will be here.

    Ye Fan was in no hurry to enter.

    He squatted on the edge of the minefield and watched the path of the remnant thunder for a long time, then slowly stretched out a foot and stepped into the scorched earth.

    As soon as he landed, a silver light came to his ankles from the cracks in the ground.

    Snap.

    Lightning exploded on his calf.

    Ye Fan paused.

    It doesn't hurt. There was just a numbness that crawled up my legs and dissipated when it reached my knees.

    The stone in his heart fell to the ground.

    The body reshaped by the second round is not even affected by the poisonous miasma of the Waste Pill Cave that can rot a living person into bones. The remaining power of the Thunder Tribulation is like scratching an itch.

    Ye Fan stood up straight and simply walked deeper into the minefield.

    He was not walking fast, and the residual thunder beneath his feet struck him one after another, collapsing on his skin and turning it into numbness.

    He lowered his head and looked at his Qing Yi, but there were several burnt black holes.

    The clothes suffer, but the person is fine.

    "If I had known better, I would have kept the rags rotten by the poisonous miasma and put them on."

    Ye Fan muttered and did not stop.

    The further you go, the more broken the terrain becomes. A piece of scorched rock was standing on edge, blocking the view.

    Just as he rounded a black rock half as tall as a man, footsteps sounded muffled in front of him.

    A figure walked out from behind Jiao Yan and crossed his path.

    He was nearly two meters tall, and the tendons on his arms were taut, and the material of his green clothes was stretched tight by the flesh.
title_en: Chapter 28 Is this the fourth level of body training?
